note: Reference HEAD (.ref) must be checked out at the same tag as preferredHostVersion; it is for research only. Runtime compatibility is tested against an installed release, not HEAD. This workbench currently targets **0.2.2-rc.1 only** — one host version, one set of slot names, one client-kernel plane. Adding another version means re-running `node scripts/test-host.mjs` against it and re-checking the three seams that differed between releases: the settings trigger slot (`settings.launcher`), the client kernel plane (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend/dist` rather than node_modules packages), and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` peer version.
